classification: Prospective section-slope sensitivity only; not an experimental correction, fitted model, VLM reproduction, stability result or full validation.

scope.activity: Read source and accepted saved text; stdlib hash/schema and scalar arithmetic only. Actual prospective runner needs its own freeze.

prospective_protocol.baseline_reuse: Reuse the six completed original-slope comparison states and two zero-flow measurement baselines. Do not recompute or relabel them as changed-slope equilibria.
prospective_protocol.nonlinear_path: Retain original cold-jig start and four nominal monotone load-continuation steps per condition; changing the initial branch path would confound this diagnostic.
prospective_protocol.change: Only both endpoint values of the explicit full-wing dCLda distribution become2*pi; no geometry, material, mass, constraint, sampling or normalization change.
prospective_protocol.outcome: Retain all six results/failures and compare twist and both root-normal/wind-normal displacement conventions against unchanged baseline, primary VLM and experiment separately. No automatic fitting or scope extension.

primary_justification.author_source: Riso and Cesnik, DOI10.2514/1.C036869, author preprint sectionIII.C pp12–13, Fig6 and Eqs8–9.
primary_justification.confirmed: The separate15-strip potential model uses a zero-thickness flat plate, aerodynamic center atc/4 and constant2*pi per-radian slope. Its3D tip weighting is fitted to primary VLM tip displacement.
primary_justification.distinction: Supplied UVLM files represent the36-spanwise-by18-chordwise-panel lifting-surface branch. Changing one ASWING section parameter does not reproduce its aerodynamic discretization, load distribution or tailored strip weighting.
primary_justification.retain_stall: Primary potential models omit stall/viscosity/thickness, but disabling our stall simultaneously would defeat the declared isolated slope test. Any no-stall experiment is a separate future study.

parsed_distribution.proof_level: Source trace plus exact saved generated ASW tables; no current parser evaluation was executed.
parsed_distribution.literal: Pazy_wing.asw lines45–50: dCLda multiplier6.1185 multiplies unit entries; all four original stations therefore give6.1185 despite doubled.52 material station.
parsed_distribution.derived: isae_ae1.py lines137–139 emits two full-domain endpoint rows with identical values. The changed case must update both endpoints.
parsed_distribution.parser: asw.py lines271–285 applies per-column multiplier/addition; lines332–340 constructs Distribution. Distribution lines77–90 uses separate natural cubic segments; Beam.value lines150–158 evaluates the declared field. A two-point identical-valued table is constant with zero first/second derivatives, so spline end conventions and side traces cannot change this slope.
parsed_distribution.no_units_conversion: dCLda is per radian (ASWING user guide line1183), unlike alpha in degrees. Neither multiply2*pi by180/pi nor apply a second scale.
parsed_distribution.no_default_substitution: A declared dCLda table overrides the2*pi default in asw.py line27. Changing DEFAULTS alone would not change these cases.
parsed_distribution.checks: Assert parsed field values and derivatives at all actual aerodynamic receivers and endpoints, and exact equality of all other distributions/records/meshes before the prospective coupled runs.

actual_section_law.virtual_geometry: Steady equations155–157, pp32–33; frozen_influence.py lines14–36. r_cp=r_hv+[a0/(4*pi)]*c/|e cross s|*e. a0=2*pi makes h=.5; baseline h is below.5.
actual_section_law.force_location: Quarter-chord bound force location and material quarter-chord moment arm do not depend on a0; do not move Xax or the structural reference line.
actual_section_law.leakage: Steady equations202–204, pp40–41; aero.py lines461–467. cl=2*Gamma/(c*Vperp), leakage=(Vperp/a0)*Ks*fstall(cl). Smooth leakage is not exactly zero below CLmax. Changing a0 necessarily changes this same law; no compensating Ks or CLmax adjustment.
actual_section_law.saturation: Post-limit lift-curve slope is approximately a0/(1+Ks); changing CLmax to preserve a nominal stall angle would add a second parameter change. The native law does not enforce a hard CL cap.
actual_section_law.induced_pressure_drag: aero.py lines552–555 retains2*rho*(vperp/Vperp)*tangency^2*c*ds even with Cdf=Cdp=0. Altered loads/drag through the solved circulation are outcomes, not additional input changes.
actual_section_law.controls: aero.py lines321–326 adds Fk*dCLdFk/a0 to incidence. Current controls are empty and derivatives undeclared(defaultzero), so this additional slope coupling is inactive.
actual_section_law.interpretation: It is not mathematically a post-processing scale on lift: changing a0 rebuilds tangency-point influence geometry, leakage and the coupled equilibrium.

cm_convention.native: Steady equations72–73 pp16–17; aero.py lines571–581: m_section=(.25-Xax)*c*c_hat cross f_lift +.5*rho*Vperp^2*c^2*Cm_corrected*ds*s_hat. Input Cm is about chord/4, positive along native span.
cm_convention.local_mach: Cm_corrected=Cm/sqrt(1-Mperp^2), Mperp=Vperp/a_sound. This remains independent of selected PG Mach0 (user guide lines2431–2434). Thus PG0 does not force local Mperp0; existing Cm0 makes this correction identically zero.
cm_convention.reference_axis: Xax=.441 and chord.1m remain unchanged; native lift-arm torque is already included. Do not add the lift-arm moment again when testing any future nonzero section Cm.
cm_convention.xfoil: Official XFOIL primer Force calculation specifies default Cartesian moment reference(.25,0), with chord-normalization caveat. For standard unit-chord airfoil axes, positive nose-up and native+span mapping follow from the pressure-integral and established chord orientation. The archived header lacks geometry-normalization/reference-command history, so that mapping is conditional, not proved by the polar alone.
cm_convention.present_action: Keep Cm0. A future Cm(alpha_local,Re) study requires its own documented axis/reference mapping and local-flow treatment.

Actual local Re requires local relative speed, chord and viscosity; current rho1.23/PG0 does not prove Re200000.
The155 samples establish stored coverage, not accuracy or validity at every sampled angle.
